card.name: Colon after a component name
card.fires_on: A colon right after a single item name (a drug or format) that begins a per-item entry, and the word "components" when it refers to parts of a combination product.

modes.label: Colon after item name
modes.description: A colon follows a drug or format name and introduces a separate entry for that item.

modes.label: Components of a product
modes.description: The word "components" refers to the individual ingredients of a combination product.
